property_summary: For any target that increments its state in its payable fallback/receive, calling C.sendMoney(target, value, data) as owner must forward enough gas so that the target's fallback executes and increments its counter when value is nonzero; replacing call with transfer (which only forwards 2300 gas) can prevent that increment for some target implementations.
change_summary: Replace call with transfer, which forwards only 2300 gas and may prevent the target's fallback from incrementing depositsCount if it needs more gas.
